decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The rear roof extension, due to its size, design and lack of sufficient set-ins, would fail to be secondary to the existing roof slope and would result in a top-heavy development, which would be detrimental to the character of the existing house and the appearance of the area, contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed single-storey rear extension, due to its excessive depth and scale, would result in an obtrusive and unneighbourly development, which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers by reason of enclosure and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension incorporating one window to front roof slope
